tolerances.rule: each tolerance is 8 times the worst absolute difference measured between the cuda provider and PyTorch float32 on the CPU, over exactly the cases in the reference files. 8 is headroom for another GPU, driver or execution provider; the OpenVINO CPU device on the same machine and day lands 2 to 3 orders of magnitude closer, so nothing in between is near a gate.
tolerances.note: a reranker logit runs to +-11 here, so the same relative error is a far larger absolute one than for a probability; that is why the logit tolerances are the widest numbers in this table. ner_token_prob doubles as the width below which two labels are a tie the arithmetic decides rather than a disagreement about the model.

aggregation_mapping.claim: the providers aggregate token-classification spans at the word level, so TURBO_AGGREGATE_SIMPLE and TURBO_AGGREGATE_FIRST both reproduce transformers' `first` strategy exactly, and TURBO_AGGREGATE_MAX reproduces its `max`. Measured on both providers above: offsets and entities equal, scores within 8e-4.
aggregation_mapping.not_reproduced: transformers' `simple` strategy is token-aligned and can split one word into two spans (`Sao Paulo` becomes `Sa` ORG plus `o Paulo` LOC; `Nikolaus Blome` becomes `Nikola` plus `us Blome`). No provider here can produce that shape. The difference is stated in providers/cuda/src/lib.rs's aggregate_spans and in docs/providers.md, and the reference stores transformers' `simple` spans so it is visible as numbers.
aggregation_mapping.gap: include/turbo/turbo_types.h documents TURBO_AGGREGATE_SIMPLE as `merge consecutive same-label tokens`, which reads as token-aligned and does not say the providers are word-aligned. The header is the one contract, so the rule belongs there, not only in a provider's source comment.

findings: ~/opt/bundles/rerank-onnx/bundle.json declares model_id `cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-12-v2`; its ONNX graph has six encoder layers, and the numbers match the L-6-v2 checkpoint to 1.2e-3 on the logits. Per PLAN.md section 2 principle 6, per-model truth lives in the bundle, so the field is a defect. It is metadata only, so the gates do not fail on it.

~/opt/models/rerank pairs the L-6-v2 config.json and ONNX with a 12-layer L-12-v2 model.safetensors. Loading that directory with AutoModelForSequenceClassification silently drops half the weights and returns plausible wrong numbers with no error; the generator refuses it instead.
~/opt/bundles/sst2-onnx and ~/opt/bundles/ner-onnx declare model_id `sst2` and `ner`, local aliases rather than the Hugging Face ids the receipts name.

transformers 5.17.0 collapses `tokenizer(query, "")` to a single segment (`[CLS] query [SEP]`), not a pair. Both providers emit `[CLS] query [SEP] [SEP]` with the trailing [SEP] in segment 1, which is the correct pair encoding: PyTorch on that encoding gives -9.262406 against the cuda provider's -9.261698. The reference builds that pair explicitly. Before the fix this one case reported a 3.3e-1 logit difference while every other case was under 1.2e-3.
status_after: The live task suite now gates on numbers. cuda and openvino both pass on rtx4080; a receipt from another machine or device is still required before either cell moves past EXPERIMENTAL.
